subject: Error message : "unsigned long long of length = 42Failed an illegal memory access was encountered"

messages.author: Anna Herz
messages.body:
Hello,
I'm running some AFE simulations using Amber22 with a hydrogen mass repartitioning factor of 3. Before the production stage, the system is previously minimised and equilibrated at each respective lambda window at 1 fs and appears to be stable.
During the production stage at 4 fs, I frequently observe the following error for some of the bound lambda windows:
"unsigned long long of length = 42Failed an illegal memory access was encountered"
I was wondering if anyone knows what this error means and what might cause it? I haven't been able to find it in any of the documentation or previous threads but I'm not sure if I've missed something.
Thank you very much!
Best wishes,
Anna

messages.author: Ryan Snyder
messages.body:
I've seen this error before when using a 4 fs timestep without the correct hydrogen mass repartitioning. Can you check the parameter file to confirm that the masses were properly adjusted?
Ryan Snyder
